purpose: Bounded, evidence-first flood twin pilot; source selection must be completed for a reviewed area of interest.

selection_requirements: documented river reach and boundary conditions
USGS gauge coverage and relevant time series
terrain product coverage and known vertical reference

sources.purpose: Monitoring-location metadata, continuous measurements, daily values, and time-series metadata.
Terrain elevation input, subject to product-specific resolution, coverage, horizontal CRS, vertical datum and accuracy review.
Effective regulatory flood-hazard reference; not a substitute for a current hydraulic model or site-specific determination.
Hydraulic model package and run outputs with separate calibration and validation evidence.

prohibitions: Do not invent an area of interest, bathymetry, CRS, vertical datum, calibration record, model hash, gauge observation, or download checksum.
Do not label a Houdini or browser screening simulation as a calibrated hydraulic model output.
Do not commit large third-party data packages or licensed project files without reviewing terms and repository-size implications.
Do not publish outputs as engineering-approved until qualified human review is recorded.
